title: mogapvqnn: noise-aware architecture search and benchmarks for post-variational quantum neural networks
description: Code, configurations, run records and analysis scripts for the article 'What Limits Post-Variational Quantum Neural Networks? Expressivity Bounds, Shot Noise and Noise-Aware Architecture Search under Amplitude Encoding' (submitted to Physical Review A). Includes a validated NumPy simulator with classical shadows, trajectory noise and readout mitigation, NSGA-II architecture search, baselines, 182 run records, post-hoc studies, and scripts that regenerate every table and figure.
